briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief — 2026-10-05 (SGT)

  • NAV S$10,298,236 (-0.64%); listed book flagged -3.45% (overstated — real listed Friday about -1%; Oct 2 base was restated down S$19.4k overnight, night 7, cumulative about -S$105.7k; vs restated base the day was roughly flat +0.03%).
  • Biggest mover: HK reopen after National Day — HSI -2.60% to 23,972, Tencent 421.20 -2.27% (below the 425 line), Xiaomi -3.96% (corporate buyback 4.1M B shares Oct 2), mainland property routed (Sunac -17%).
  • The one thing: Friday NFP shock +29K vs +84-90K consensus (July revised to -10K, net revisions -60K) and the long end ignored it — 10y closed UP at 5.28%. Second straight soft print the bond market refused to buy. Term-premium regime confirmed; defense-sleeve gate now requires a rally-and-hold, not just a soft print.

Flag integrity — day 5 of the stale-baseline glitch

  • 7 critical flags, same signature: SMIC -5.6% false (actual -0.66%), Xiaomi -8.8% direction-real 2.2x overstated (actual -3.96%), GDX -5.5% false (actual +1.20%), SILJ -6.8% false (actual +0.44%), SLVP -5.8% unverifiable (peers +0.4 to +1.0%), listed-book -3.45% overstated.
  • CDL -14.8% is EXACTLY right and real — fifth straight down day, S$7.04, cumulative 8.26 to 7.04 = -14.77%. Largest real drawdown in the book.
  • priceErrors: L46.SI Yahoo 404, 17th session.

Insider (last 7 days)

  • Wing Tai: September filing run holds at 18, latest Sep 29 (director dealings); no October filings on IR page as of Oct 5. source
  • No other substantial-shareholder/director filings found for held SGX or HK names.

Congress (window Oct 1-5)

  • Senate Dem (RI): SOLD JPM x2, Visa x2, Analog Devices; traded Sep 4, filed Oct 1.
  • House Dem (WA-1): muni rotation 4 tickets at $250-500K each (Boulder CO schools buy; CA Community Choice sell; Central Valley Energy buy; San Joaquin Clean Energy buy+sell); filed Oct 1.
  • House Dem (VA-8): munis $15-100K (Univ Missouri buy, Indiana ST buy, Ohio GO sell); filed Oct 2.
  • House Rep (OH-2): AMGN buy, HD buy x2, MPC sell x2 ($1-15K); filed Oct 2.
  • House Dem (LA-6): GOOG, AAPL, MSFT x2, NFLX all buys ($1-15K); filed Oct 2.
  • Nothing in held tickers. source

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • NFP +29K shock; Goolsbee (2027 voter) refuses to rule out any decision.
  • Iran decision point: Camp David secret meeting Friday; Trump — easy way or hard way; B-1s pulled from RAF Fairford; tanker struck in Hormuz Sunday; Houthis hit Aramco facility in Riyadh; Iran oil minister resigned.
  • G7 agreed up to 100M bbl diesel+crude emergency release (4-month pace per Macron); no diesel export ban; OPEC+ held Nov quotas. WTI -1.7%.
  • Fed independence pressure: Hassett urged Powell to leave the board; Bessent downplayed yields and called AI bubble talk alarmist; ~$100 checks to 20M+ seniors; White House AI task force (czar Clayton).
  • Trade: China anti-dumping probe on EU chemicals; Trump warns Korea on Alaska pipeline; first Belarus potash shipment in 4 years.
  • Joint US-Japan FX intervention announced (USDJPY ~158); SoftBank Son flags AI safety worries; NK hypersonic IRBM test.

Risk

  • All 7 daily.json flags restated above; 5 false, 1 direction-real, 1 exact (CDL).
  • Concentration: SG property cluster (CDL, UOL, Wing Tai, Yanlord, Ho Bee) under simultaneous drawdown; CDL -14.8% cumulative.
  • FX: about 35% of net worth non-SGD; USD 1.2793, USDCNY about 6.70, USDHKD about 7.847.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz at about $60.42 futures x 1.2793 = about S$137.3k vs S$56,240 loan — equity about S$81.1k, about 1.69x. A -5.9% silver day = -10% equity. $60 close-below is the active watch line.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Defense sleeve hold-fire: 10y must rally-and-hold sub about 5.15% on soft data, or 30y capitulation above 5.75%, before deploying. NFP +29K was the soft print and 5.28% close was the refusal — gate not met.
  • HK barbell: Tencent 425 line broke Friday on 18% average volume (provisional); mainland returns Oct 8 to confirm. Xiaomi corporate is buying the dip (HK$99.2M Oct 2).
  • Silver/miners: $62 add suspension stands; $60 is the new line. Deutsche Bank flags silver oversupply; Heraeus calls $60 the key test. Miners (GDX +1.2%, SILJ +0.4%) diverging up from spot — watch for confirmation.

Market context (Friday close)

  • SPX 7,723 +0.73%, NDX 30,808 +1.00%, DJI 51,182 +0.49%, RUT 2,833 +0.94%; VIX 15.31 -6.59%.
  • 10y 5.28% (up on soft NFP), DXY 101.92, WTI -1.7%, Brent +0.5%, spot gold +0.2%, BTC +1.3%.
  • GDX $87.78 +1.20%, SILJ $27.23 +0.44%, SLVP not captured (Thu $34.85); silver Dec futures about $60.42 -1.24%.
  • STI 5,634.82 -0.58%; SGX (S68.SI, not held) -7.16% on 4.5x volume — board-lot reduction announced (100 to 10 shares, effective today, incl DBS/Keppel), no confirmed fundamental driver.
  • USDSGD 1.2793, USDCNY about 6.70.

trumpWatch.title: NFP shock: +29K vs +84-90K consensus
trumpWatch.detail: September payrolls +29K, u3 4.2% (participation 61.8%), AHE +0.1%/3.0%; July revised to -10K, net revisions -60K. Dovish pop pared — 10y closed UP at 5.28%, second straight soft print the long end ignored. Goolsbee (2027 voter) won't rule out any decision.

trumpWatch.title: Iran at decision point
trumpWatch.detail: Secret Camp David meeting Friday; Trump: decision pending, 'easy way or the hard way'; B-1s pulled from RAF Fairford; tanker struck in Hormuz Sunday (UKMTO); Houthis hit Aramco facility in Riyadh; Iran oil minister Paknejad resigned; IRGC threatens vessels/bases if ground attack.

trumpWatch.title: G7 emergency oil release; OPEC+ holds
trumpWatch.detail: G7 agreed up to 100M bbl diesel+crude release (Macron: 4-month pace); Trump rules out diesel export ban, SPR fill 'soon'; OPEC+ held November quotas. WTI -1.7% Friday.

trumpWatch.title: Fed independence pressure builds
trumpWatch.detail: Hassett urged Powell to leave the Fed board (HQ renovation report); Bessent downplayed yields and called AI bubble talk 'alarmist'; Trump ~$100 checks to 20M+ seniors via Medicare Part B; White House AI task force (czar Clayton) to report on AI risks.

trumpWatch.title: Trade tit-for-tat
trumpWatch.detail: China anti-dumping probe on EU chemicals; Trump warns Korea he will 'charge South Korea more' on Alaska pipeline; first Belarus potash shipment in 4 years.

trumpWatch.title: Joint FX intervention; NK missile
trumpWatch.detail: US-Japan joint FX intervention announced (FinMin Katayama: 'FX trend has changed somewhat'; USDJPY ~158); SoftBank's Son flags AI safety worries; North Korea hypersonic IRBM test.
